system.description:
Twists fate against a victim, from a brief evil-eye hex to lasting rites of cursing. Folk blame curses for every misfortune, so beware the torch-bearing mob.

Spell. Hex: Spellcasting at Close Range against the target's Sorcery Defense. The target gains a non-Sorcerous drawback of your choice for a short time.

Ritual. Alignment: Rite of Cursing: Challenging (9) Knowledge, 1 hour (a greater rite: Formidable 12). Invocation: Formidable (12) Will, 3 to 5 hours. Unleashing: Will against the target's Sorcery Defense; longer and crueller curses need Destiny invested or burned.

Art of Malediction — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 101.
system.resonances: None (spell), or a link to the target (ritual).
